test_title: PYST 12: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Ministry co-organised the 9th edition of the Global Technology Summit (GTS) with Carnegie India in April 2025 in New Delhi?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ministry of External Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of External Affairs** (MEA) is responsible for India's external relations, including diplomacy, trade, cultural exchange, and international cooperation.
 
• The Global Technology Summit (**GTS**) is an annual event that focuses on **technological advancements**, **policy discussions**, and **global collaboration**.
 
• The 9th edition of GTS, held in **April 2025 in New Delhi**, is co-organized by MEA and **Carnegie India**, emphasizing India's role in global technological leadership.
 
• The summit brings together experts, policymakers, industry leaders, and academics to deliberate on **emerging technologies** and their impact on society, economy, and governance.
 
• The Ministry of External Affairs plays a pivotal role in **forging international partnerships**, facilitating cooperation, and showcasing India's achievements in technology and innovation.
 
• By hosting such events, MEA highlights India's commitment to being a leader in the field of technology and its application for global development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**__

 __
 
• The **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting** is responsible for the formulation and administration of rules and regulations related to information, broadcasting, and cinema in India.
 
• It primarily focuses on **media**, **entertainment**, and **public awareness campaigns**.
 
• It oversees organizations like **Prasar Bharati (Doordarshan and All India Radio)**, and the **Press Information Bureau**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Communications**__
 __
 
• The **Ministry of Communications** handles policies related to **telecommunications** and **postal services**.
 
• It oversees departments like the **Department of Telecommunications (DoT)** and **India Post**.
 
• Its focus is on expanding connectivity and digital infrastructure across India.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology**__
 
 
• The **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)** deals with the promotion and development of the **IT industry** and **digital governance** in India.
 
• It is responsible for initiatives such as **Digital India**, e-Governance, and cybersecurity policies.
 
• MeitY supports innovation and startups in the field of technology but does not oversee international relations directly, which is the domain of MEA.
